reason: A DSH settings marketplace for searching GitHub-hosted community plugins and skills and installing selected repositories through the dsh CLI; human review is warranted because installation launches child processes and may modify build-script approval configuration.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置中提供社区插件和技能市场，用于搜索 GitHub 仓库并安装选定项目。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH settings marketplace for searching GitHub repositories and installing selected community plugins and skills.

capabilities: Fetches GitHub repository search results, metadata, manifests, and Git trees
Provides a settings marketplace tab with search, repository listings, and install controls
Spawns dsh plugin add as a child process to install selected repositories
Installs detected DSH skills into the user's DSH skills directory
Can update pnpm-workspace.yaml allowBuilds entries after explicit user approval and retry an installation
